page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-16 is an x86_64 virtual machine instance configured with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 62 GB of RAM. The instance is powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor featuring 8 physical cores and 2 threads per core. The CPU architecture includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, as shown by its stress-ng single-core score of 3449.99 and high single-threaded compression speeds, with gzip compression reaching 37.95 GB/sec. Multi-core scaling is more moderate, with stress-ng multi-core performance and PassMark CPU scores falling into the average tier. Memory performance is strong, placing in the top 25% on the PassMark memory score, while memory bandwidth and database operations remain in the average tier.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4d-standard-16 offers a balanced resource density of approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU, making it highly suitable for workloads that benefit from strong single-threaded execution and moderate memory capacity. Recommended workloads include general-purpose web serving, single-threaded data processing, and standard database operations.
